shape: 2-portal diagonal arena with NW perimeter loop + east clique
description: Two-portal stage with a west-side north entry (Z≈-8) and a SE south entry. Direct N→S route runs lufu37 → c8pfbm → dcodjn → a5dnxi (4-anchor diagonal). A NW perimeter LOOP wraps around the upper-left: lufu37 → 70or0n → 33l4ep → 27d68q → cmlrpl → c8pfbm. The east side is a triangle clique (dcodjn + q07794 + a5dnxi) with a 2-hop SE dead-end chain (sbhbe0 → n3p8g2).

portals.north: spawn_north at (-19.07, -8.08) — gate on the west (low-X) column, north of midline
portals.south: spawn_south at (18.96, 23.09) — gate on the south (high-Z) side, east column

anchors.description: north entry hub - west wall mid (matches lufu37)
west wall upper - NW loop step (matches 70or0n)
central west bridge - NW loop closer (matches c8pfbm)
east-central hub - bridge to east clique (matches dcodjn)
south entry hub - east clique anchor (matches a5dnxi)

traversalNotes: Direct N→S: spawn_north → north_inner → center → east_hub → south_inner → spawn_south. 5 hops.
NW PERIMETER LOOP: north_inner → west_upper → nw_corner → n_arc → n_arc_s → center → north_inner. Use for north-side detour objectives.
EAST CLIQUE: east_hub + east_mid + south_inner is a triangle — three short paths.
SE pocket (se_pocket_a → se_pocket_b) is a 2-hop dead-end off east_mid — corner objective.
DISPATCH RULE: center is the canonical NW-loop↔east bridge; east_hub is the east clique dispatcher.
